instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\segmented_flange.dxf. Import segmented_flange.dxf. Draw a six-segment flange centered at (80,80) with outer radius 65, inner radius 38, six radial CENTER segment lines every 60 degrees, six diameter 9 holes on radius 50 starting at 30 degrees, and text ACAD-29. Use OUTLINE for the outer flange circle, CUTOUT for the inner circle, CENTER for radial segment lines, HOLE for holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
